content: I was charged $49.99 twice for the same monthly subscription this morning. My account shows only one active plan, and I need the extra charge reversed because it affects a bill due tomorrow. I have both transaction IDs ready. Can you fix this?

I can help you work through it, but I can’t access your account or reverse charges from this chat.

Because you need the money for a bill tomorrow, take these steps now:

1. **Check whether both charges are posted or whether one is pending.** A pending charge may be an authorization hold rather than a completed duplicate payment.
2. **Contact the subscription provider’s billing support** with both transaction IDs and ask for an urgent duplicate-charge refund. You can send:
   > “I was charged $49.99 twice this morning for the same monthly subscription, but my account shows only one active plan. Transaction IDs: [ID 1] and [ID 2]. Please verify the duplicate charge and reverse the extra $49.99 urgently—it affects a bill due tomorrow. Please confirm the resolution and when the funds will be available.”
3. **Call your bank or card issuer today.** Ask whether they can release a duplicate pending authorization or help with a posted duplicate charge. Explain the deadline; a refund may not become available by tomorrow.

Which subscription service charged you, and are the two charges **pending or posted**? Don’t share your full card number, password, or security code here.

Wait, why are you telling me to contact another department or my bank? I'm talking to support right now. I already told you I have the transaction IDs ready—I shouldn't have to do all this legwork to get my own money back.

Can you actually process this refund yourself, or are you just sending me in circles?

You’re right—I should have been clearer instead of giving you a list of handoffs. **I can’t process the refund myself.** This chat has no access to your billing account or payment system, so I can’t verify the transactions, issue a refund, or open a support ticket. Providing the transaction IDs here won’t let me act on them.

I’m sorry for the runaround, especially with a bill due tomorrow. If you reached this chat through the subscription provider’s support page, request **a billing agent who can review both transaction IDs and issue a duplicate-charge refund**. You shouldn’t need to repeat troubleshooting first.

Even if they approve it today, I can’t promise the money will be available tomorrow. Ask them specifically whether they can **void the duplicate payment immediately**, rather than send a refund that takes days.

You said to request a billing agent, but that just sounds like another handoff. Can you give me a direct contact or link to reach a billing agent immediately, or is there a specific phone number I can call to expedite this issue given my urgent situation with the bill due tomorrow?

I can help find the right billing contact, but **I need the subscription provider’s name** to give you an accurate link or phone number. I don’t want to send you to the wrong place or invent a number.

Which service charged you, and what country are you in? If the provider isn’t clear, share the merchant name shown beside the charge—**not your card details or transaction IDs**.

I can then help identify the official billing-support route. I can’t guarantee immediate access to an agent or that a refund will clear before tomorrow.
